title: Yeasty Flaky Kenyan Dum Bun
description: A festive Kenyan dish featuring vanilla bean paste and flaky pastry, perfect for breakfast or brunch. This recipe is diabetic-friendly and makes 4-6 servings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm milk and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add sugar, salt, and 1 cup of flour to the bowl. Mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the dough until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the remaining flour, 1/2 cup at a time, until the dough comes together in a ball.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough over the filling to form a bun, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each bun.
Brush the tops of the buns with melted butter.
Bake the buns in a preheated oven at 375°F for 18-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the buns cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
